# dsh-valuation-service
A deterministic financial-data and valuation plugin for **DeepSeek Harness**. It reads a workpaper l
ayout of `01.json` / `02.json` / `04.json`, computes six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF input sl
ots, comparable PS / PE and IRR, and writes one unified schema per project set.
It registers one agent tool, **`valuation_service`**. No AI inference, no invented numbers: anything
missing is left blank and marked `missing` for a human or a downstream research step to fill.
## What it computes
| Block | Content |

| `ratios.historical` | profitability, solvency, efficiency, cash flow, valuation, growth |
| `ratio
s.forecast` | forecast-period profitability / growth / expense; BS- and CF-dependent ratios marked m

issing |
| `dcf` | full input slots (WACC, g, tax, EBIT, D&A;, capex, ΔWC, net debt), outputs, missi

ng list, hand-off anchors |
| `comparable` | PS and PE in parallel: trimmed mean, all-sample mean, 1

-year mean, pre-money multiple, premium |
| `irr` | target / conservative / optimistic, closed-vs-op

en judgement, deviation |
| `assumption_diff` | material assumptions vs assumptions computed from ac

tuals, field by field |
| `pending` / `gate` | unresolved conflicts and C2–C7 gate status when the w
orkpapers carry them |

## Tool usage
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- `base` (string, optional): workpaper root; relative paths resolve against the session working dire

ctory.
- `projects` (string or array, optional): restrict to these project directory names.
- `write

` (boolean, optional, default `false`): write `<base>/valuations-service.json`.
- `out` (string, opt
ional): override the output path.
The tool returns a per-project summary (DCF status and missing list, PS/PE status, IRR closed flag,
assumption-diff count, gate) plus the output path.

## Formulas
- Ratios: gross / operating / net margin, ROE, ROA; current / quick / cash ratio, debt-to-equity, de
bt-to-assets, interest coverage; asset / inventory / receivables turnover and days; OCF ratios; PS /

PE / EV / EV-EBITDA; revenue and net-income growth.
- DCF: `FCFF = EBIT × (1 − t) + D&A − capex − Δ
WC`; `TV = FCFF_last × (1 + g) / (WACC − g)`; `EV = Σ PV(FCFF) + PV(TV)`; `equity = EV − net debt`.
- Comparable: trimmed mean (10% each side when n ≥ 5), all-sample mean, 1-year mean, pre-money multi

ple, premium.
- IRR: `(exit value / invested capital) ^ (1 / years) − 1`.
- Assumption diff: materia
l assumption vs module-computed actual, per field.
Ratio formulas are adapted from anthropics/claude-cookbooks · analyzing-financial-statements/calcula
te_ratios.py (MIT), mapped onto Chinese three-statement labels.
## Adaptation layer
Data variants are handled in one place instead of per project:
| Variant | Function | Rule |
| raw layout (`{bs,is,cf}` vs report-title sections) | `_normalize_raw` | normalize by 资产负债表 / 利润表 /

现金流量表 keywords |
| units (thousand / ten-thousand / million CNY) | `_unit_for` | field-name suffix

first, then `forecast.unit` |
| field-name variants | `_find_param` | keyword match + exclusion word

s |
| total vs line item (`资产总计` vs `流动资产合计`) | `_find_val` | totals require an exact match, no subs

tring fallback |
| self-comparison in the comp set | `_included` | drop rows whose `treatment` says

自比 / 剔除 |
| no market PE multiple | `comparable.pe.status=assumption` | use the assumption range exp
licitly, never present it as a market multiple |
If a new variant is structural (layout / unit / naming), add it to the adapter. If it is a measureme
nt convention, add it to the skill formulas. If data is missing, leave it blank and mark `missing`.
## DCF hand-off
Missing DCF inputs stay blank; `dcf.m3_handoff.anchors` lists what each one needs:
| Missing input | Anchor to fill |

| WACC | risk-free rate / beta / equity risk premium / capital structure |
| g | long-run GDP growth

/ industry terminal growth |
| capex | capex plan / construction in progress / capacity expansion |

| D&A; | depreciation and amortization policy |
| ΔWC | receivables / inventory / payables turnover

forecast |
| tax rate | effective tax rate |
| net debt | interest-bearing debt − cash |
## Test
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The test builds a synthetic three-project workpaper set in a temporary directory (no client data), r
uns the service, and checks ratio values, DCF missing slots, comparable status, IRR and the written
, and checks ratio values, DCF missing slots, comparable status, IRR and the written aggregate file.
## Boundaries

- No AI inference, no model calls, no network requests.
- No client data or project names are shippe

d in this repository.
- Missing inputs are marked, not fabricated.
- It does not replace a valuation
model: it standardizes inputs and keeps the slots.
